capabilities.title: Choose the RL algorithm, training backend, and compatible versions
capabilities.summary: Algorithm-to-adv_estimator mapping (GRPO/GAE/RLOO/ReMax/...), backend options (FSDP/FSDP2/Megatron x vLLM/SGLang), key hyperparameter defaults, and version constraints.

when: Choosing an RL algorithm for LLM post-training (critic-free vs value-based).
Selecting training and rollout backends for a verl run.
Setting rollout/training/KL hyperparameters for a new config.

steps: Algorithm selection by adv_estimator: grpo (critic-free, math/reasoning), gae (PPO, dense rewards, needs critic), reinforce_plus_plus (variance reduction), rloo (leave-one-out baseline), remax, opo.
Backends: training FSDP / FSDP2 / Megatron-LM; rollout engines vLLM, SGLang, HuggingFace Transformers; models 0.5B-671B (Qwen-3, Llama-3.1, DeepSeek, Gemma-2).

Key defaults: rollout.n=8 samples/prompt, temperature 0.7, top_p 0.95; actor.lr 1e-6, ppo_mini_batch_size 64, clip_ratio 0.2; use_kl_loss true with kl_loss_coef 0.001 (GRPO) / 0.02 (PPO), adaptive target_kl 0.1.
Version constraint: vllm>=0.8.5,<=0.12.0 — avoid vLLM 0.7.x (known bugs).
Alternatives routing: Megatron-native training -> slime or miles; PyTorch-native Monarch abstractions -> torchforge; simple SFT/DPO only -> TRL or Axolotl.

capabilities.title: Train a math-reasoning model with critic-free GRPO
capabilities.summary: Prepare a parquet dataset with prompt/reward_model columns, define a rule-based reward, configure GRPO, and launch verl.trainer.main_ppo across the GPU cluster.

when: RL post-training a reasoning model on math-style tasks (GSM8K, MATH) with verifiable answers.
A critic-free RL algorithm is preferred (no value model to train).
avoid_when: Only simple SFT/DPO is needed — use TRL or Axolotl instead of an RL training stack.
Dense rewards need value-based advantage estimation — use the PPO/GAE workflow with a critic.

steps: Prepare the dataset as parquet with a 'prompt' column (chat-message list) and a 'reward_model' column carrying ground_truth.
Define a rule-based reward function mapping (responses, ground_truths) -> rewards (e.g., extract \boxed{...} and compare to ground truth).

Write the GRPO config: algorithm.adv_estimator=grpo; data.train_batch_size, max_prompt_length, max_response_length; actor.use_kl_loss=true with kl_loss_coef=0.001; rollout.name=vllm with n=8 samples/prompt.
Launch: python3 -m verl.trainer.main_ppo --config-path config --config-name <name> trainer.n_gpus_per_node=8.
Monitor WandB/TensorBoard loss curves and verify reward increases over steps; evaluate on a held-out test set.

validation: Reward is increasing over training steps.
Loss curves are visible and stable in WandB/TensorBoard.
Held-out evaluation is run after training.
recovery: OOM during rollout: set rollout.log_prob_micro_batch_size=4, enable model.enable_gradient_checkpointing, or use strategy=fsdp2 with fsdp_config.offload_policy=true.
Training instability (loss spikes, reward collapse): lower actor.lr to 5e-7, raise kl_loss_coef to 0.01, set max_grad_norm=1.0.

capabilities.title: PPO with a critic model (GAE advantage estimation)
capabilities.summary: Add a critic model and switch to GAE when the task has dense rewards that benefit from value estimation.

when: The task has dense rewards where value-based advantage estimation (GAE) helps.
A separate critic/value model is acceptable overhead.
avoid_when: Critic-free training suffices (math/reasoning with verifiable rewards) — use GRPO.

steps: Set algorithm.adv_estimator=gae with gamma=0.99, lam=0.95.
Configure the critic: critic.model.path (same or different from the actor), critic.ppo_mini_batch_size=64.
Set PPO actor knobs: use_kl_loss=true, kl_loss_coef=0.02, clip_ratio=0.2.
Launch: python3 -m verl.trainer.main_ppo algorithm.adv_estimator=gae critic.model.path=<model> trainer.n_gpus_per_node=8.
Monitor reward and loss as in the GRPO workflow.

validation: Reward increases without collapse and loss shows no sustained spikes.
recovery: Training instability: lower actor.lr to 5e-7, raise kl_loss_coef, enable max_grad_norm=1.0.

capabilities.title: Large-scale RL training (>70B) with Megatron and a multi-node Ray cluster
capabilities.summary: Convert the model to Megatron format, configure tensor/pipeline parallelism, start the Ray cluster across nodes, and launch multi-node training.

when: The model exceeds ~70B parameters or needs expert parallelism.
A multi-node GPU cluster with NVLink/InfiniBand is available.
avoid_when: The model trains on a single node — FSDP/FSDP2 avoids the Megatron conversion step.

steps: Install the Megatron-LM bridge: pip install mbridge; convert the model to Megatron checkpoint format.
Configure: model.backend=megatron, actor.strategy=megatron, tensor_model_parallel_size=8, pipeline_model_parallel_size=2; rollout.name=vllm with tensor_parallel_size=8.
Start the Ray cluster: ray start --head --port=6379 on the head node; ray start --address='head_ip:6379' on each worker node.
Launch: python3 -m verl.trainer.main_ppo trainer.nnodes=4 trainer.n_gpus_per_node=8.

validation: All worker nodes joined the Ray cluster before launch.
Training steps proceed without persistent weight-sync stalls.
recovery: Slow weight sync (long pauses between rollout and training): use strategy=fsdp2 for faster resharding or set trainer.async_weight_update=true.

capabilities.title: Triage verl training failures by symptom
capabilities.summary: Symptom-to-remedy map for the four documented failure classes: rollout OOM, training instability, slow weight sync, and vLLM version mismatch.

when: A verl run crashes, stalls between rollout and training, or shows loss spikes / reward collapse.

steps: CUDA OOM during the generation phase -> rollout OOM: reduce log_prob_micro_batch_size, enable gradient checkpointing, or FSDP2 CPU offloading.
Loss spikes / reward collapse -> instability: reduce lr to 5e-7, raise kl_loss_coef to 0.01, clip gradients (max_grad_norm=1.0).
Long pauses between rollout and training -> slow weight sync: strategy=fsdp2 or trainer.async_weight_update=true.
Import errors or generation failures -> vLLM version mismatch: pin vllm>=0.8.5,<=0.12.0 and avoid 0.7.x.
